finding: The installed Node directory fast path does not forward mode. The earlier no-filter reproduction requested COPYFILE_FICLONE_FORCE but that option alone is not proof of copy-on-write. Filtered copies reach copyFileSync and fail ENOSYS with that flag.
replacement: macOS clonefile(2) per file/link, CLONE_NOFOLLOW=1, no fallback. Scratch source remained unchanged after clone write; symlink text and file modes matched. Qualification fixtures use this explicit native mechanism.
